title: Short-term cooling and refrigerator storage
summary: Cool suitable produce promptly while controlling condensation and cross-contamination.
steps: Remove field heat as soon as practical using the storage conditions suitable for that crop.
Use clean breathable or moisture-controlling packaging instead of sealing wet produce blindly.
Keep raw animal products below and separate from ready-to-eat garden produce.
Label harvest or preparation date and rotate oldest suitable food first.
Discard slimy, leaking, mouldy or strongly abnormal produce; trimming does not make every spoiled food safe.
